lines.text: With the wall rebuilt and the doors set, Nehemiah put Hanani in charge and ordered the gates kept shut until the sun was hot.
The city was large but had few people, so God put it into Nehemiah's heart to gather the nobles for enrollment by genealogy.
Nehemiah found the scroll of the Law of Moses, which listed those who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem and Judah.

wrong_details.wrong: the scroll of the Law of Moses
wrong_details.true: the genealogical register of those who first returned

lines.text: Priests who could not find their family records were excluded as unclean and told not to eat the most holy things until a priest consulted the Urim and Thummim.
The whole assembly numbered 42,360, and after giving to the treasury, all the Israelites moved inside Jerusalem's walls to live by the seventh month.

wrong_details.wrong: all the Israelites moved inside Jerusalem's walls to live
wrong_details.true: they settled in their own towns
